networks.name: agent_network_board
networks.description: A verifiable control room for the open agentic web: discover published networks, inspect declared capabilities, route work through browser agents, and audit real cross-origin activity.
sample_queries: Inspect https://roshameow.github.io./agent-network-board-peer/receipt_notary and show what it can do.
Prepare a handoff to the receipt notary peer to verify a receipt digest and summarize the evidence.
Audit this run and show which origins were contacted.

llm_router.note: The keyless default is an explicitly labelled deterministic inference adapter running in the visitor's browser. BYOK profiles replace it with the visitor's OpenAI-compatible router; keys are never sent to peer sites.

peer_policy.note: Public agent artifacts are reachable like web pages. Every third-party contact is shown in a consent card; peer manifests cannot replace the caller's router and private context is denied by default.

exports.description: Inspect this site's agent network and audit a real browser run.
